avis.titre: A Real Support Cream for Mature Skin — Hydrating, Smoothing, and Well Worth UsingA Real Support Cream for Mature Skin —
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry mature skin, I pay close attention to creams that claim peptide support. A lot of them sound impressive on the label but end up feeling like basic moisturizer with trendy words added. This one feels more purposeful. I’ve used several Tosowoong creams at this point, and this is exactly the kind of formula that reminds me why I keep coming back to the brand. The texture is very nice. It feels creamy and nourishing without being too heavy, and it spreads easily over the skin. On my dry skin, it gives that comfortable, cushioned feeling I want from a moisturizer, but it does not sit on top in a greasy layer. It absorbs well and leaves my skin looking smoother, calmer, and more hydrated. Ingredient-wise, copper peptide is the obvious star here. GHK-Cu is one of those ingredients that gets a lot of attention because it is associated with skin repair, firmness support, and overall healthier-looking skin. I do think expectations matter, though. This is not going to act like a prescription retinoid, replace procedures, or suddenly reverse deep wrinkles. That is not realistic for a cream. Where this performs really well is as a supportive moisturizer for skin that needs consistent maintenance. Mature skin often needs barrier support, hydration, and ingredients that help skin look stronger and less tired over time. That is where this fits beautifully into a routine. I also like that this is not just “copper peptide” and nothing else. The formula includes

avis.titre: Excellent Moisturizer for Soft, Healthy SkinExcellent Moisturizer for Soft, Healthy Skin
avis.texte: I really like this cream! It has a rich but lightweight texture, absorbs quickly, and keeps my skin moisturized without feeling greasy. My skin feels much softer and smoother after using it. A little goes a long way, and the quality is excellent. I would definitely buy it again and recommend it to anyone with dry or sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Moisturizing, Supportive, and I am loving it!
avis.texte: I love this product so much. It helps maintain and when needed repair my skin barrier. As an esthetician this has been a more affordable and effective product I’ve been able to recommend to my clients. I have clients who are improving crepe skin, cystic acne, compromised barrier, rosacea, scarring, sensitive skin, and more with this. Consistently is key to any regimen and this consistently used works amazing!!! The product is very moisturizing and absorbs nicely into the skin. I’ve noticed increased healing and faster fading of healing acne inflammation. No fragrance and I haven’t had a reaction nore has others that I’ve recommended it to. I always recommend patch testing before diving in. Over all this is a great addition to mine and my clients routine.

I’ve been using this face cream for a few weeks, and I’m very happy with the results. It keeps my skin feeling soft, smooth, and well hydrated without being greasy. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and leaves my skin looking fresh and healthy. I would definitely recommend it!

I really enjoy this cream. It has no real fragrance to it, spreads nice and evenly on my skin and is a decent moisturizer. The reason I took a star off is because I don’t feel like it has done much for my skin after 3 months of daily usage. Not sure if the copper in it is active but I can see little blue spheres in it when I go to put it on my face but I’m not seeing any difference in texture or elasticity. I’ll finish my current tube but I don’t think I’d repurchase this because it is not more than a nice facial moisturizer.

I have been using this cream for 8 days, I went in skeptical like every other cream that claims to smooth, lighten etc I am 40 years old and we play soccer all year round with my youngest, I also have oily skin and try to protect it. This is the ONLY cream I have used that has actually lightened my dark spots on my cheek and eye lid, my pores look smaller and my skin feels hydrated without that heavy oil feel!! The application is so easy, goes in before you moisturizer. It is worth every penny. I highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: Tube isn’t filled all the way
avis.texte: Tube was not filled all the way. It seems about 1/4 of the tube was empty. It’s not filled all the way.

I am on my second tube of this copper cream . I LOVE IT!! I have not had any skin irritation. The tube is good size and I only need a pea size for my face. I use it on my crepe "old lady neck" as well! ha I have very dry skin and it is all I need under my makeup. This dream absorbs well and is not greasy. It is fragrance free. I tell all my friends about the cream. Highly reccomend!

avis.titre: Skin absorbs the product very quickly so you dont have to wait to layer with sun block or foundation
avis.texte: Wonderful texture...sinks into skin beautifully...sadly for me not enough hydration. It claims to be intensely hydrating so I bought it as I have dry skin. It is more suitable for normal skin.
Nach 4 bis 5 Wochen sieht meine Haut schöner aus und sie ist mega weich. Ich kaufe die Creme wieder.

50yo guy with an honest review. I've never had a skin routine before. I've washed my face with barsoap my entire life and that's all. A bit of moisturiser if I ever got sunburnt, otherwise nothing. I've been using this stuff for about a week and I can feel a difference. I don't think my skin looks any different, but it definitely feels smoother and maybe softer. All I do is put this on after a shower, and when it dries, I put a bit of the kids' moisturiser (cerave) on after. I'm not sure it will change anything dramatically but I like the way my skin feels and will keep using it. One caveat, instructions say to use 'a pea sized amount'. This is unrealistic. It takes about 3 pea sized amounts to do face and neck.
Love this product. Been using for a couple of weeks now and really makes the skin glow

avis.titre: Tiny Blue Beads, Real Results: Copper Peptides That Actually Deliver
avis.texte: If skincare had a VIP section, copper peptides would be front row with a velvet rope! With this cream from TOSOWOONG Copper Peptide Cream, basically holding their own backstage pass. Honestly, it makes a pretty convincing case for why it deserves a spot in your routine. The ingredient listed as Copper Tripeptide-1 (often written as GHK-Cu) is the real deal: GHK-Cu is a naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide found in human plasma, saliva, and urine that acts as a potent tissue repair, regenerative, and anti-inflammatory agent. It decreases with age, dropping from 200 ng/mL at age 20 to 80 ng/mL by age 60, prompting its use in anti-aging. It supports collagen production, skin repair, and overall skin regeneration. In other words it’s not just a trendy ingredient, it’s one with real, studied benefits. What I love about this formula is that you can actually see it working, literally. The cream contains tiny blue beads (visible in the photos), which are encapsulated copper peptide spheres. As you apply it, they melt into the skin, giving you that satisfying “okay, something legit is happening here” feeling. Then there’s the packaging, which I didn’t expect to love as much as I do. It comes in one of those metal-style dispensing tubes, the kind that feels like something out of an old-school apothecary or classic skincare line. It’s oddly satisfying giving it that “they actually cared about what they put in here” vibe. Now for the results: I’ve been using this consistently fo

avis.titre: Great for over 40 year old skin!
avis.texte: Added this to my over 45 year old skin care routine along with the A313. AWESOME 👏🏼! I wake up with glowy, hydrated skin. Packaging was great, no drips or damage.

avis.titre: See a glow right away, highly recommend this product
avis.texte: I’ve been reading about the wonders of copper peptides for the skin and found this lovely product on Amazon and just had to try it based on the reviews and the price! I can tell you I see a glow almost instantly since I started using it. Highly recommend trying this product

I've been using this consistently for the past two weeks and this has changed my skin in so many ways. My acne flair ups cleared up, my skin is moisturized, and my the uneven skin tone improved. I was shocked, two weeks! What a life saver. Please don't ever change this formula.

I was so excited to use this product after seeing all the great reviews, but after 2 days of use I now have a very red rash situation. I have no known allergies to anything else, and have generally clear skin so I’m unsure what’s in this that I may be allergic to. Also no other changes to my lifestyle besides using this cream. Hope this doesn’t happen to anyone else and genuinely disappointed it didn’t work for me. ☹️

avis.titre: Amazing for helping with skin elasticity!
avis.texte: Holy cow it works! After I was forced into early menopause through breast cancer treatment, my skin elasticity just went downhill. The first picture I’m posting is June of last year, and the second one is today. My neck looks so much better. I can’t believe this product actually did what it said it would do. I’ve heard so many good things about peptides, I’m starting to believe the hype. !
Got this fr my daughter so I pray it does what it says it will do

Honestly saw a huge difference in my lower belly skin. After 2 kids and losing weight I heard blue copper peptides were the way to recover elasticity. Im feeling really confident about using this for for the lose of the next 30lbs. I will say you will get itchy in sensitive areas like breast and arms but thats only because it helps the skin start repairing collagen.

avis.titre: Thick copper peptide cream, great for night time use
avis.texte: Oo this is nice. The blue color comes from the copper, I dont see any dyes in the ingredients. The little blue spheres are like little orbeez gel balls. The burst at the slightest touch. There is no fragrance ingredients, but the cream smells very softly of petroleum. The smell disappears quickly. The product feels emollient and a little heavy on the skin, but for me that is perfect for night time use. It does absorb nicely and did not leave me feeling greasy. I have very sensitive, reactive, dehydrated aging skin and I had zero reaction to this. Copper and peptides are excellent for anti-ageing.

The TOSOWOONG Copper Peptide 12 Cream contains 99% Purity of Copper Tripeptide-1, and 12 Multi Peptides along with a Hyaluronic Acid Complex to help keep your skin hydrated and plump. The copper peptides work together to assist in treating skin tone, texture, dark spots, and create a stronger skin barrier to help prevent signs of aging overall. Going on it's a light, but rich gel cream that creates a gentle blanket over the skin's surface. Over the past two weeks of using it, I've noticed an overall smoothness and even a glow I can't explain. Needless to say, my skin is bouncy, hydrated and doesn't feel or look dull. With naturally oily skin, thankfully it doesn't leave me feeling overly oily and I can easily use this along with any serums I've used them with. Plus there isn't much of a scent at all which I appreciate in general. So far, I'm a fan and I"m here for the ride.

avis.titre: Hydrating, Lightweight, and Packed with Peptides
avis.texte: This Copper Peptide Cream from TOSOWOONG delivers a surprisingly luxe experience at a budget-friendly price. The formula is rich yet lightweight, absorbing quickly without any sticky residue. What makes it stand out are the microcapsules of copper peptides—each one bursts on contact, releasing a fresh dose of concentrated anti-aging ingredients. After application, my skin felt deeply hydrated and noticeably softer. As it dried down, I saw a visible reduction in fine lines, especially across my forehead. The finish is smooth and non-greasy, making it ideal for both day and night use. With consistent use, I expect even more firming and elasticity benefits to emerge. At under $30, this cream punches well above its weight. A little goes a long way, making it a smart investment for anyone seeking effective, science-backed skincare without the luxury markup. Highly recommend.

Great quality cream with effective ingredients. It refines, plumps, and brightens my skin, provides deep and lasting moisture, and diminishes fine lines and pores. There are little blue capsules in the cream that burst as you massage the cream into your skin. The texture is a gel-cream that easily absorbs into my skin without any residue or stickiness. It doesn’t have a scent as far as I can tell and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. It’s a big bottle too and it doesn’t take much product to cover your face so I expect it will last me quite a while, so it’s definitely a good value for the price too. Def recommend!

avis.titre: Effective peptides, hydrates, and anti-aging agents.
avis.texte: Right off the bat, this feels like a smart investment. You’re not just paying for fancy names—this serum packs in a high concentration of copper peptide (GHK-Cu), plus a roster of supporting peptides, hydrators, and skin-friendly ingredients. Therefore, this is a value for your money. This product has lightweight, non-sticky gliding softness that seems to absorb into the skin easily. The key ingredients of peptides, hydrators proved to be effective on my aging, dehydrated skin.

This is an excellent copper peptide cream. It absorbs into your face quickly and is really smoothing and hydrating. My skin feels glowy and youthful after using this stuff. I love peptides and this is chock full of them. This is a very effective anti-aging cream from one of my favorite K-beauty brands. This is a great value at the price point.

avis.titre: Great multi-peptide cream, high amount of copper peptide; fast absorption, no scent
avis.texte: I’ve used several products from this particular Korean brand, and some are truly exceptional for me. This copper peptide 12 cream appears to be among the exceptional ones. Peptides are super-popular right now in Korea and Europe, some consider them even as an alternative to retinoids. Copper tripeptide-1 (GHK-Cu) is a very expensive peptide and used in skincare creams in a very small concentration, ranging usually within 0.001 – 0.01 % (10–100 ppm). Product description says that this cream contains 99% purity of copper tripeptide-1 in pretty high concentration of 1000 ppm (0.1%), which is really great to have in this product as clinical studies demonstrate that this ingredient can increase collagen and ellastin production in the skin. Besides this star ingredient, the ingredient composition of the cream includes also niacinamide, panthenol, multi-peptide blend of 11 other great peptides, several types of hyaluronic acid and collagen derivatives, multiple plant extracts, allantoin, adenosine. From my perspective, it is a very good combination of active ingredients, which I normally want to have in my skincare products. This cream is milky white with blue beads of incapsulated copper peptide; lotion-like body texture; no fragrances, no scent. When I first saw this aluminum tube, I thought that cream might be on a much thicker side, but it’s not. I believe aluminum tube works here as the most effective barrier against light, oxygen and moisture, as copper peptide is sensitive to

I had never tried copper peptides in my skincare regimen, but I had heard good things, so decided to give it a try. I have been using it for almost a month a few times a week. I love the light blue color and you can actually see the little blue peptide beads in the cream! It goes on smoothly and has no odor or really any scent, which is a good thing. It's very hydrating and the cream is really thick. I have noticed some firmness everywhere except my undereye area. I wouldn't say it's a miracle, but it works pretty well. I was hoping for the "glass" skin, but I'm probably a little old for that anyway. :)

I prefer pump and tube dispensers as opposed to jars that require fingers to be dipped in regularly so I am very happy with this toothpaste like tube of anti-aging cream. It contains a long list of interesting ingredients that seem promising and have potential to help my dry, sensitive and aging skin. It is too early to tell if this is something I would actually re-order, but overall I like it well enough so far and feel optimistic about it being effective for my skin. I am very happy that it doesn’t include any added fragrance and doesn’t cause my skin any extra redness or irritation. It is lightweight, but feels very hydrating for my super dry skin. It absorbs nicely and doesn’t feel sticky. For the current price of under thirty dollars, this is a great value because I normally pay triple that for my regular moisturizer. I will continue to use this, and if it seems to be doing something by the end of the tube, I will definitely consider re-ordering it. I am not necessarily a huge fan of the blue granules, but I could get past this if it produces great results.

If you want peptides, and who doesn’t, this is a seriously good moisturizer. If you want a product that looks pretty to display on your vanity, this isn’t it. But if you want great ingredients and a clean formula I’m not sure you can do much better than this. The moisturizer comes in what looks like an ointment tube so it’s nothing luxurious but that does mean it has what’s probably the best safety and freshness seal imaginable. So while the tube might be anything special, the cream certainly is. It has a great texture that spreads smoothly and easily. It almost liquifies, absorbing quickly and leaving no heavy coating, no greasy feeling and no sticky tacky skin. Plus it gives a dose of everything my aging skin wants! Lots of peptides with the star being cooper peptide. Niacinamide and a form of Vit C for brightening plus lots of antioxidants and moisturizers. It is fragrance free and essential oil free so there is no scent with this cream. It’s easy to add into a routine and a great way to get helpful peptides. And it’s from a Korean skincare company that has a great reputation and a huge fan base. Can’t go wrong with this cream in my opinion! The price is very reasonable considering what quality and the brand’s track record.

I really like this "Copper Peptide 12 Cream" by TOSOWOONG. I had a little bit of trepidation about trying it, because I've seemed to react to other peptide creams I've tried in the past (red lumps come up on my skin the next day.) But this is one of the first peptide creams I've not reacted to! It is really pleasant to use. The cream feels silky when you rub it onto your face and your skin feels super hydrated after. I often use this as my main moisturizer after I've used toner and a serum first. It is lightweight, but it keeps your face moisturized. One thing I noticed, is that it doesn't have as dramatic blue flecks as the listing photos shows, in truth it is much more subtle looking. I do see a slight blue fleck every now and then, but for the most part this presents as a simple white cream. I do think that it is doing a good job on my skin so far, it is a cream I often reach for to use both in the morning and at night and sometimes in the day, specifically for my middle-aged forehead which seems to need more moisturizing than the rest of my face! I really like this so far.

Beautifully done cream. I have heard wonderful things about this brand- and I can finally agree! I prefer cream products because I have very dry and sensitive skin- but I want to use effective products to keep my skin looking young. This cream comes in a LARGE tube, generous for the price, and is smooth and light and absorbed so quick! I used d’alba face spray right before applying to enhance absorption, and it absorbed beautifully! Did not cause any irritation or anything! I’m so impressed by this brand and happy I found an anti aging product that I can use on my skin from a brand with a proven track record. For the price and size of the tube this is an excellent deal! See photo for size reference in my bag. Became a new part of my routine!

avis.titre: copper peptide in a hydrating (but not greasy) cream
avis.texte: I ordered this cream because I love Tosowoong skincare and I have never tried a copper peptide cream. I have and use so many serums, and copper peptides usually come in serum form, so this one was interesting to me. With a slight blue tint and tiny, darker blue microcapsules, this cream is lightweight enough to absorb well without greasiness but has enough viscosity to add much-needed hydration. It is fragrance-free and gentle, and didn't cause irritation even on more sensitive areas of my skin. Copper peptides take a bit of time to show anti-aging results, but after a couple weeks what I can say for sure is that it works well to lightly moisturize, give my skin a hydrated "bounce" texture, and add a healthy glow. The tube is a large 1.69 ounces, making it a good value for a multi-peptide cream from a well-known Korean skincare line.
